svg.aria-label: SeatLock: High-Contention Seat Reservation System. Ordered row locks load-tested with k6 across 4 concurrency models, eliminating deadlocks. Real-time availability streamed via SSE backed by LISTEN/NOTIFY. Built with Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Docker.
